keyword: how often should a small business blog
angle: Publishing frequency is the single biggest lever small businesses can pull to multiply traffic and leads — data shows clear thresholds where output converts to measurable growth.
secondary_kw: how many blog posts per month

stats.claim: Companies publishing 16 or more blog posts per month get 3.5x more inbound traffic than companies publishing 0–4 posts per month.
Companies publishing 16 or more blog posts per month generate 4.5x more leads than companies publishing 4 or fewer posts per month.
B2B organizations blogging 11 or more times per month receive 3x more traffic than those blogging just once a month.
B2B SaaS websites publishing 9 or more blog posts per month saw 3.6x the organic traffic growth rate of those publishing just 1–4 posts monthly.
stats.source_name: Stratabeat 2025 B2B SaaS SEO Performance Report

stats.claim: Bloggers publishing multiple times per week are 76% more likely to report strong results — 37% vs 21% for average publishers.
B2C organizations blogging 11 or more times per month generate 4x more leads than those blogging 4–5 times per month.
